purpose: Teach: 酸味/聞き手/山脈/晩餐/人魚/占星術/静脈/堤防

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、レモンの酸味、お絵描きで表現してみてね
lines.en: Sho, try drawing what lemon tastes like—that sour feeling.
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Soft opening, like making space for a small voice. Gentle pace, almost conspiratorial—you and him discovering together. Slight lift at the end, encouraging without pushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの聞き手になりたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to be someone who listens to you.
lines.style: Small, steady voice. No performance—just the honest weight of what he's saying. Slight pause before 'listen,' like he's finding the exact words. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとアルプス山脈を見に行きたいわね
lines.en: Sho, I'd really like to see the Alps with your dad someday.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant gaze in the voice. Slow, measured pace. Like she's picturing it as she speaks. Tender underneath—not sad, but carrying the weight of a quiet wish.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの晩餐に呼んでほしい
lines.en: Mei-sis, will you invite me to dinner with you?
lines.style: Hopeful, eager without being demanding. Voice goes up slightly at the question. There's a kind of earnest vulnerability—wanting to be included matters to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが人魚姫の絵描いてあげるわね
lines.en: Sho, I'll draw you a mermaid princess, okay?
lines.style: Soft, almost whispering. Slow delivery like she's already imagining it. Warmth settling into the words. Trailing-off at the end—a promise made gently, just for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、占星術って当たるのかな?
lines.en: Mei-sis, does astrology actually come true?
lines.style: Curious, wondering aloud. Small voice, genuinely perplexed. Like he's asking because he trusts her to think about it with him, not to have an answer.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが採血で静脈から採られたんだって
lines.en: Sho, your dad got blood drawn from his vein yesterday, didn't he?
lines.style: Calm, informational but with underlying gentleness. Like she's checking in—not alarmed, just noticing something. Slightly lower register, matter-of-fact but with care underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんと堤防沿いをお散歩したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went for a walk with Grandpa along the embankment.
lines.style: Warm, pleased with himself. Speaking from a small happiness—something good happened and he wants to tell her. Steady pace, no hesitation. Pride in the memory.
